title: 物理约束数字孪生保障城市人流传感器完整性：检测隐蔽虚假数据注入
summary: 该研究针对城市行人计数系统，提出物理约束数字孪生方法，通过图局部化增益与流量守恒残差检测隐蔽虚假数据注入，并采用自适应保形校准设定告警阈值。在墨尔本六年数据上，攻击裕度达0.54，三分之一设备受损时降至0.19，验证了守恒律而非局部性的关键作用。
summary_en: This work formalizes stealthy false data injection for city-scale pedestrian sensing and proposes a physics-constrained digital twin that estimates directed flows on the pedestrian street graph, assimilates counts via a learned graph-localized gain, and detects attacks by combining innovation with a flow conservation residual, with thresholds set by adaptive conformal calibration. On six years of Melbourne data, the attack margin reaches 0.54 against a single compromised device and 0.19 when a third of the fleet is compromised, showing the gain comes from the conservation law rather than locality.
